title: Deployment and validation of an AI system for detecting abnormal chest radiographs in clinical settings.
summary: The deployed VinDr-CXR system was compared with reports at Phu Tho General Hospital; it achieved F1 0.653 (95% CI 0.635–0.671), accuracy 79.6%, sensitivity 68.6% and specificity 83.9% for any abnormality. This establishes real-world performance with a substantial drop from laboratory results.
ai_technology: CAD combines convolutional image models for abnormality detection/classification within the hospital PACS workflow.
